description:
Adds map generators that put geological features from more than one climate on the same map.

Each generator is a stock one with extra features confined to regions of the map, so one side can look different from the other. The main one is Mountains to delta, for the temperate climate: a river system that rises in mountains at one end of the map, gathers tributaries through rolling hills, meanders across a plain and ends in a delta on a sea with islands. Lakes lie along the rivers, and the mountain valleys open into flat floors where towns can grow. Pick it from the Generator list in the new game dialog. The Rivers slider sets how many tributaries there are and the Lakes slider how many lakes.

Ground textures and vegetation stay those of the chosen climate.

AI Disclaimer: Claude Code was used to create this mod.
name: Mapzilla
summary: Map generators that mix geological features from different climates.
